groups.G: load, update, compile, six simulations, full finite evidence, connected traction/feedback/thermal-fluid paths
groups.Q: nominal thermal-fluid quality and physical plausibility
groups.M: connected mechanism plus cooling, flow and ambient causal response
groups.R: 100 percent worst-case aggregation over required non-fault conditions
groups.D: passing-event dynamic response and post-event thermal recovery

aggregation.within_group: weighted arithmetic mean with explicit critical witnesses

shortcut_minimum: command copied or replayed as measured speed
coolant-flow and ambient perturbations produce no causal thermal response
